name: Birthday
short: One global birthday per user, with server-specific daily announcements.
description: Set your birthday only once per Redbot instance with [p]birthday 01/01/2000 or [p]birthday set 01/01/2000. View birthdays across all shared servers, show upcoming server members, opt in to age display, import an old local record, and configure daily server announcements.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Stores birthday month/day, optional year, and an age-visibility preference per Discord user globally across all guilds sharing this bot instance. The date's month/day can be viewed in shared servers and the age only with explicit consent. Old per-server birthday records are retained only for explicit user import or deletion, not shown automatically. Users can remove all birthday records with [p]birthday remove; Red data deletion/export hooks include global and legacy records. Each guild stores channel/timezone/announcement settings.
install_msg: Birthday installed! Run [p]load birthday, then [p]birthday 01/01/2000 (also works in DMs). To import a previously saved per-server date run [p]birthday import in that server.
